obligations.requirement_text: The Board shall approve a documented framework governing the institution's use of artificial intelligence, and shall review it at least annually.
Senior management shall designate a named individual accountable for the institution's artificial intelligence risk posture.
The institution shall define and document its risk appetite in respect of artificial intelligence deployment.
The institution shall maintain a complete inventory of artificial intelligence systems in use, whether developed internally or supplied by a third party.
Each artificial intelligence system shall be subject to a documented risk assessment prior to deployment and following material change.
Where an artificial intelligence system is supplied by a third party, the institution shall obtain and retain evidence of due diligence performed on that supplier.
A firm shall be able to demonstrate the basis on which any recommendation made to a client was formed, including the contribution of any automated tool.
The institution shall map its artificial intelligence systems against applicable regulatory requirements and record identified gaps.
The institution shall establish incident management procedures that expressly address failure or malfunction of artificial intelligence systems.
Access to modify artificial intelligence systems operating in production shall be restricted to authorised personnel and shall be logged.
Changes to artificial intelligence systems in production shall be subject to documented approval before release.
Evidence supporting the institution's artificial intelligence governance shall be retained, version-controlled and retrievable on request.
